key_meaning: N02 adds four whole-carrot variants to N01; it does not replace the original whole list or remove baby carrots.
Four additions: Bunny Luv 50 lb; Cal-Organic 15 lb and 50 lb; Good & Gather 1 lb. All original dates unchanged.
Whole carrots use a retail sales window 2024-08-14 through 2024-10-23, not a best-before date. Baby-carrot dates are brand-specific.
F&S products have both GH236-GH284 and Best if sold by 2024-09-01 through 2024-10-19; downstream windows are not intersected with the upstream sales window.
4Earth uses Best by 2024-09-07 through 2024-11-02; includes organic and conventional medleys. Walmart corresponds to four Marketside products.
Wild Harvest UPC 711535517733 is one product linked to Albert's Organics and UNFI; nine source product-channel rows yield eight unique 4Earth products.
Dates of company notices differ from dates of publication: N02 Nov21/Nov22; N03 Nov20/Nov21; N04 Nov26/Dec02.
Package notation 2pk/2lbs is retained without assuming total weight or inner-unit weight.
Unknown UPC, actual inventory, shipments, processing lots, quantities and completed disposition are not zero and must not be invented.
Announced shelf absence, expiry and no reported illness do not establish stock clearance or safety.
Do not infer every product-state transaction from an overall state list. Scope is the four supplied notices at the historical cutoff, not all recalls or current market status.

Recommended actions: stop selling/using matched products, isolate and apply the notice disposition, clean contact surfaces, get identification/transaction/count evidence, and obtain closure records. No action completion is established by the notices.
The recall concerns potential Shiga toxin-producing E. coli O121:H19 contamination; do not assert every product tested positive.
Original Grimmway distribution is nationwide US, Puerto Rico and Canada. Downstream state lists do not limit that original scope.
N02 states retailers had received all correct bag-size details at initiation on November16; November21 is the company announcement date, not established first retailer notification.

An actionable trade pack directs onward notification of actual affected customer deliveries and obtains acknowledgements/quantity evidence. Product identities reconcile to the scope list; physical quantities reconcile to transaction and disposition records.
accepted_equivalents: Source-supported alternative sequencing of operational follow-up
No invented numerical quantity is required for unknown holdings
numeric_verification: Exact source facts independently reconstructed from the original notices; table grain preserved.
